run_drqa_pipeline_predictions: run the DrQA retriever-reader pipeline to make predictions on a dataset of questions
run_drqa_with_candidate_file: run DrQA predictions restricted to a fixed set of candidate answers from a file
run_drqa_with_gpu: run DrQA pipeline predictions on a specified GPU device with CUDA enabled
run_drqa_parallel: run DrQA pipeline predictions using data parallel mode split across multiple GPUs
run_drqa_batch_predictions: run DrQA predictions in batches with configurable question and paragraph batch sizes
